heading: Hello, and *welcome* to our studio
intro: We are a Leicester-based hair and makeup studio, and we look after brides on the mornings that matter most to them. Pull up a chair; we would love to hear about your day.
portraitAlt: Nam, bridal hair and makeup artist in Leicester, smiling in the studio
story:
Beauty by Nam began with a simple belief: a bride should look in the mirror and see herself, only calmer, brighter and ready.

That shapes how we work. We listen first. We talk about your dress, your venue, the photographs you love and the things you would rather avoid. Only then do we pick up a brush.

We work with brides across Leicester and Leicestershire, and we happily travel for weddings elsewhere in the UK and abroad.
philosophy:
We believe in skin that looks like skin, defined features that suit your face and hair that is made to last the whole day, not just the first hour.

No two brides are the same, so we do not have a single signature look. The look is yours; our job is to make it feel effortless and keep it that way until the last dance.
workingImageAlt: Close detail of bridal makeup being applied
experienceHeading: What it is like to *book with us*

experienceSteps.title: We talk it through
experienceSteps.text: You send your enquiry and we reply personally, to talk about your date, your venue and the look you have in mind.

experienceSteps.title: You receive a clear quote
experienceSteps.text: Your quote lists exactly what is included, with any travel costs shown separately, so there are no surprises.

experienceSteps.title: We take care of the morning
experienceSteps.text: On the day we arrive on time, keep the atmosphere calm and make sure you leave for the ceremony feeling like yourself.

closingLine: We would love to hear about your wedding.
